decision: Selected the centroid of Duval County parcel 0738420000R, the only property-roll parcel for 421 West Church Street (one 257,884 sq ft building on 0.73 acres), as the project locator for Cologix JAX1, a data centre and meet-me room inside that multi-storey building.
layer: Florida Statewide Cadastral (FeatureServer layer 0, FloridaGIO organisation on ArcGIS Online): Florida Department of Revenue Property Tax Oversight compilation of county property-appraiser parcel polygons joined to the 2026 real property roll (exported August 2026); CO_NO 26 is Duval County

facts.centroid_method: planar centroid in EPSG:32617 (WGS84 / UTM) of the polygon(s) returned with outSR=4326, transformed back to WGS84; geodesic areas on the WGS84 ellipsoid; native-CRS rings transformed locally with pyproj as a cross-check

identity_bridge: Cologix's JAX1 page (version of 22 September 2026) gives the facility address as 421 West Church Street, Jacksonville, Florida, and says Cologix operates a Jacksonville data center and the Meet-Me-Room at 421 West Church Street in the central business district; the JAX2 page links JAX1 at '421 W. Church St.'.

An envelope query over downtown Jacksonville returns exactly one parcel with PHY_ADDR1 '421 W CHURCH ST': 0738420000R (land 31,734 sq ft, one building of 257,884 sq ft built 1959, effective year 1990).

The roll's owner of 0738420000R is SBA Edge Jax LLC, an organisation, consistent with a carrier-hotel building in which Cologix is an occupant; ownership is recorded here only as an identity check and is not used as a role claim.

The roll codes the parcel DOR 003 (multi-family, 10 units or more) with 92 residential units, so the building is mixed-use; the operator's JAX1 is an 11K SQFT data-centre space inside it, not the whole building.

consistency_checks.datum: WGS84 output from the service (outSR=4326); native layer CRS NAD83(2011) Florida GDL Albers (EPSG:6439), cross-checked locally
consistency_checks.personal_data: Only organisation names occur in the owner field returned; no mailing-address or personal fields are reproduced.
